name: Greater London Authority
sds_name: The London Plan (spatial development strategy for Greater London)
status: Draft new London Plan published 16 July 2026. Statutory consultation closed 15 October 2026.
next_step: Examination in public expected in 2027. Adoption currently anticipated early 2028.
note: The London Plan is made under the Greater London Authority Act 1999, not the 2025 Act.

name: Greater Manchester Combined Authority
status: No SDS yet. Places for Everyone (joint plan for nine districts, adopted 2024) and district local plans are the current strategic framework.
next_step: GMCA is recruiting to lead preparation of the Mayor's first SDS. No consultation dates published.

name: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority
sds_name: Liverpool City Region Spatial Development Strategy
status: Three rounds of engagement held, most recently 'Towards a Spatial Development Strategy' (Nov 2023 to Feb 2024).
next_step: Next draft SDS (Stage 4 public participation) anticipated for consultation in late 2026. No exact dates published.

name: West Midlands Combined Authority
status: Initiation and scoping. First public questionnaire closed 12 December 2025.
next_step: WMCA says a first draft will go to public consultation, most likely in 2027.
note: Covers the seven constituent metropolitan boroughs only.

name: West Yorkshire Combined Authority
status: No SDS consultation yet.
note: The five councils and WYCA are also preparing the Mass Transit Spatial Development Framework, a joint local plan document rather than an SDS (shown below as a related plan).

name: South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority
status: No SDS consultation yet.

name: North East Combined Authority
status: Work began July 2025. MHCLG funding accepted March 2026.
next_step: Ambition to adopt by 2028. No consultation dates published.

name: Tees Valley Combined Authority
status: Consultant team appointed to lead options assessment and a draft SDS.

name: West of England (with North Somerset)
sds_name: West of England Spatial Development Strategy
status: Stage 1 initiation and scoping since summer 2025.
next_step: Provisional: initial public engagement on a vision autumn/winter 2026; draft SDS consultation summer/autumn 2027; examination 2028; adoption spring 2029.
note: The SDS covers the Combined Authority area plus North Somerset.
